Museo Naval, Madrid

LocationP.º del Prado, 3, Retiro, 28014 Madrid, Spain
Visited7 September 2016
WebsiteMuseo Naval

Museum Report

The Museo Naval is in the heart of Madrid, next door to the Spanish Navy Headquarters. It is an impressive and well-presented museum, however the focus is very clearly on the sailing navy, and apart from a few paintings and models, I found very little on the 20th Century.

But there was a very interesting model of the seaplane carrier Dedalo, which is quite an unusual ship.

They had a small gift shop there. There weren’t many books on display, but when I enquired about a book covering 20th Century warships, they pulled out a copy of Buques de la Armada Espaňola - Historiales (1700-2014) - an incredible book containing the detailed history and specifications of every vessel that has served in the Spanish Navy during that period. At nearly 1,000 pages in length, It is not a small volume - much to my wife’s annoyance it effectively doubled the weight of my suitcase on the first day of a 3-week multi-country vacation when we were supposed to be travelling lightly - but it remains one of my prized possessions, and always makes it onto the list of the top 5 items I would grab if my house ever caught on fire!
